==About me==

Started reading the Wheel of Time in 2004 as I was after a long series of fantasy books to read.  The series is amongst my favourite books and is my favourite High Fantasy. 

==Favourites==
===Wheel of Time books===
*1.  The Eye of the World
*2.  The Shadow Rising
*3.  The Great Hunt
*4.  The Gathering Storm
*5.  The Fires of Heaven
===Characters Like===
*1.  Verin 
*2.  Asmodean
*3.  Loial
*4.  Thom
*5.  Mat
*6.  Lan
*7.  Tam
*8.  Cadsuane
*9.  Rhurac
===Characters Dislike===
*1.  Padan Fain
*2.  Nynaeve (sometimes despised a lot sometimes not)
*3.  Aviendha
*4.  Mazrim Taim
*5.  Weiramon
===Scenes/Sequences===
*1.  Mat during the Battle of Cairhien
*2.  Perrin saving the Two Rivers
*3.  Portal Stone to Falme
*4.  Through the ''ter'angreal'' door
*5.  Verin saying she is Black Ajah
*6.  Egwene getting raised to Amyrlin
*7.  Thom and Moiraine discussing each other in the Stone
